## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Saññojanavippayuttasaññojaniyaduka* (Patthana 8.25) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the Paṭṭhāna collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [Catalog; SuttaCentral]. It treats the conditional relations of phenomena classified under the dyad (*duka*) of states that are disconnected from fetters but are themselves favorable or subject to fetters (*saññojanavippayutta saññojaniya*) [Catalog; SuttaCentral].

Neither SuttaCentral nor DharmaNexus records any curated or automated cross-language parallels in Chinese, Sanskrit, or Tibetan traditions [SuttaCentral; DharmaNexus]. However, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus indicates extensive Pali-internal shared material, detecting 184 matching passages across 27 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. The closest textual reuse occurs with other treatments of fetters and related defilements within the Paṭṭhāna itself, most prominently the *Saññojanagocchaka* (Patthana 2.4, sharing 69 matches and 11,243 characters, with its longest alignment between §1.1_1–2.1 and §251.1–252.1_1) and the *Saññojanagocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.5, with 14 matches) [DharmaNexus]. Significant textual links also connect it with the *Kilesavippayuttasaṁkilesikaduka* (Patthana 8.56), the *Saññojanasaññojaniyaduka* (Patthana 8.23), the *Parāmāsadukādi* (Patthana 8.33), the *Saññojanasaññojanasampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.24), and the *Upādānagocchaka* (Patthana 2.11) [DharmaNexus]. No modern standalone translation of this section is listed on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
